_comment: Feature flags live here, not in LaunchDarkly. See docs/adr/0002-feature-flags-in-repo.md. Change a flag by opening a PR; the deploy picks it up. Owner: @jordan.

checkout.express_pay.why: Apple Pay / Google Pay on the cart page. Shipped after the Feb 2025 flag decision.

payments.retry_queue.why: All charges go through the retry queue. Turning this off re-enables inline retries, which double charged 212 orders. Do not turn this off.

images.hosted_cdn.why: Kept as a kill switch to flip to a hosted CDN if our image server falls over. Revisit when traffic doubles (ADR 0003).

search.elastic_backend.why: Elasticsearch adapter never shipped. Postgres full text is the only backend (ADR 0005).

images.thumbnail_cron_v2.why: Idempotent thumbnail cron after the Aug 2026 outage.
